---
title: "Scary Book of the Week"
date: "2006-10-23"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

It’s hard to know what aspect of this book (extracted in [Der Spiegel](http://www.spiegel.de/international/0,1518,443306,00.html "Der Spiegel")) is the scariest: the mercantilist assumption of a ‘world war for wealth,’ arguing for a multilateral US-EU FTA as an economic NATO against a bizarre caricature of the East, or the fact that the ‘best-selling’ author was ‘Economic Writer of the Year’ in 2004.  Then there are laugh-out-loud statements like this:

> *The EU Commissioners are the last true believers in the religion of free trade.*

It does serve to illustrate that mercantilist thinking is extremely resilient, not least in Europe, and that arguments for free trade are never entirely won.
